doors.note: 174 US locator entries: 13 Brand House + 2 unbannered full-price 'Under Armour - ' stores (Bozeman MT, King of Prussia Mall) = 15 own-door; 156 Factory House + 3 Clearance House = 159 outlet. Factory House includes separate Youth (Pittsburgh, Sevierville) and Footwear (Orlando Vineland) sub-stores listed as own entries; ~10 Factory Houses sit in non-outlet centres (Huntsville, Meridian, Wichita, Freeport ME, Rochester, Avon OH, Antioch, Fort Worth, Fredericksburg) - counted outlet by banner. Detail pages contain 'temporarily closed' only as i18n template strings - no store flagged closed. No stated total on the locator to compare against; directory crawl is exhaustive for listed states. Minor locator typos kept (Hunstville, Oultets).
